Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000877" [decision]: As of 2025-12-18, the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000623" [constraint]: The product catalog deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000336": In the product catalog, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000332" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: product catalog, image metadata)
- memory_id "1000319": The product catalog depends on the image resizer for thumbnails.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000156": The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000110": The Cinder team owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder team, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000823" [decision]: As of 2025-11-27, Yuki Tanaka is on call for the Cinder team this cycle, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder team, Diego)
- memory_id "1000748": As of 2025-10-16, the Cinder team sits on the third floor.  (about: Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000727": As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000723": From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team instead of the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000667": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000664": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000660": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000650": On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway over to the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000628": The Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Cinder team, auth gateway, the runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000400" [decision]: The Cinder team adopted trunk-based development.  (about: Cinder team, trunk-based development)
- memory_id "1000395": The Cinder team observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder team, webhook dispatcher, the cache change)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka is on the Cinder team.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000870" [decision]: As of 2025-12-18, Lena has the Boreal team pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000526" [decision]: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000786" [decision]: As of 2025-11-06, Marcus has the Boreal team pager this cycle, taking over from Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000810" [decision]: As of 2025-11-26, the image resizer is owned by the Atlas team, which the Ember team owned until then.  (about: Atlas team, Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000802" [decision]: As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team looks after the bus, which the Boreal team looked after until then.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000778": As of 2025-11-06, feature-flags is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000706": The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000561" [decision]: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000586" [decision]: As of 2025-08-15, Marcus has the Boreal team pager this cycle, taking over from Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000742": On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the image resizer's owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer, the marketing send)
- memory_id "1000555": As of 2025-07-30, the Atlas team consists of Priya Raman, after Tomasz left the team.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
